## 1. Data Loading and Recoding

```{r load-data}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

CSV_PATH <- "/root/.claude/uploads/7e325fe5-5704-55cc-9ede-a4a3bdde6097/a9a78d92-Qinghe_Survey_Integrated_v2.csv"

raw <- read.csv(CSV_PATH, sep=";", fileEncoding="UTF-8", check.names=FALSE)
cat("Shape:", nrow(raw), "x", ncol(raw), "\n")

# --- Q22: Pre-project information access (text → ordinal 0/1/2) ---
recode_q22 <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(str_to_lower(x))
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "not informed|no information|not answered") ~ 0L,
    str_detect(x, "consulted")                                ~ 2L,
    str_detect(x, "informed")                                 ~ 1L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
}
q22_col <- grep("Q22", names(raw), value=TRUE)[1]
raw$q22_ord <- recode_q22(raw[[q22_col]])
raw$q22_bin <- if_else(raw$q22_ord > 0, 1L, 0L, missing=NA_integer_)

# --- Q23.x: channel indicators → info_score and consult_score ---
chan_cols <- grep("^Q23\\.", names(raw), value=TRUE)
consult_chans <- grep("Q23\\.6|Q23\\.7|Q23\\.13", chan_cols, value=TRUE)
info_chans    <- setdiff(chan_cols, consult_chans)

yn_to_bin <- function(v) {
  v2 <- str_trim(str_to_lower(as.character(v)))
  case_when(v2 == "yes" ~ 1L, v2 == "no" ~ 0L,
            v2 == "1"   ~ 1L, v2 == "0"  ~ 0L,
            !is.na(v) & v2 != "na" ~ NA_integer_,
            TRUE ~ 0L)
}

chan_mat <- as.data.frame(lapply(raw[, chan_cols, drop=FALSE], yn_to_bin))
raw$n_info_chans    <- rowSums(chan_mat[, info_chans,    drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
raw$n_consult_chans <- rowSums(chan_mat[, consult_chans, drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
raw$info_score      <- raw$n_info_chans    / length(info_chans)
raw$consult_score   <- raw$n_consult_chans / length(consult_chans)

# --- Q24: Signage (text → ordinal 0/1/2) ---
q24_col <- grep("Q24", names(raw), value=TRUE)[1]
recode_q24 <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(str_to_lower(x))
  case_when(
    x == "no"                           ~ 0L,
    str_detect(x, "did not understand") ~ 1L,
    str_detect(x, "understood")         ~ 2L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
}
raw$q24_ord <- recode_q24(raw[[q24_col]])

# --- Q25: Terminology clarity (1–5; 6=DK → NA) ---
q25_col <- grep("Q25", names(raw), value=TRUE)[1]
raw$q25  <- as.numeric(raw[[q25_col]])
raw$q25[raw$q25 == 6] <- NA

# --- Q26: Maintenance rating — PRIMARY SATISFACTION OUTCOME ---
q26_col <- grep("Q26", names(raw), value=TRUE)[1]
raw$q26  <- as.numeric(raw[[q26_col]])
raw$q26[raw$q26 == 6] <- NA

# --- Q27: Binary satisfaction ---
q27_col <- grep("Q27", names(raw), value=TRUE)[1]
raw$q27_bin <- if_else(str_trim(str_to_lower(raw[[q27_col]])) == "yes", 1L, 0L)

# --- Q12–Q21: Performance composite ---
perf_cols <- grep("^Q1[2-9]|^Q2[01] ", names(raw), value=TRUE)
perf_mat  <- as.data.frame(lapply(raw[, perf_cols, drop=FALSE], function(v) {
  x <- as.numeric(v); x[x == 6] <- NA; x
}))
raw$perf_composite <- rowMeans(perf_mat, na.rm=TRUE)

# --- Normalise participation indicators to [0,1] ---
raw$q22_norm <- raw$q22_ord / 2
raw$q24_norm <- raw$q24_ord / 2
raw$q25_norm <- (raw$q25 - 1) / 4

# --- IAP2-weighted Participation Level composite ---
W_Q22 <- 0.35; W_CHAN <- 0.15; W_Q24 <- 0.20; W_Q25 <- 0.30
raw$PL <- W_Q22 * replace_na(raw$q22_norm, 0) +
          W_CHAN * replace_na(raw$info_score, 0) +
          W_Q24 * replace_na(raw$q24_norm, 0) +
          W_Q25 * replace_na(raw$q25_norm, 0)

# --- Participation group ---
raw$part_group <- factor(case_when(
  raw$q22_ord == 0 ~ "None",
  raw$q22_ord == 1 ~ "Info",
  raw$q22_ord == 2 ~ "Consult",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
), levels=c("None","Info","Consult"), ordered=TRUE)

# --- Nearby subsample: within 1km ---
dist_col  <- grep("Q10", names(raw), value=TRUE)[1]
raw$nearby <- str_detect(str_to_lower(raw[[dist_col]]), "within 500m|within 1km")

# --- Working datasets ---
df_sat   <- raw %>% filter(!is.na(q26))
df_full  <- raw %>% filter(!is.na(q22_ord), !is.na(q24_ord), !is.na(q26)) %>% drop_na(q22_norm, q24_norm)
df_nearby <- df_sat %>% filter(nearby)

cat(sprintf("N total: %d | N with Q26: %d | N complete: %d | N nearby: %d\n",
            nrow(raw), nrow(df_sat), nrow(df_full), nrow(df_nearby)))
cat("Q22 group counts:\n"); print(table(raw$part_group, useNA="ifany"))
cat("Q26 ceiling (==5):", round(100*mean(df_sat$q26 == 5, na.rm=TRUE), 1), "%\n")
```

## 2. Descriptive Statistics

```{r descriptives}
library(knitr)

desc_var <- function(v, label) {
  x <- v[!is.na(v)]
  data.frame(Variable=label, N=length(x), Mean=round(mean(x),3),
             Median=round(median(x),3), SD=round(sd(x),3),
             Min=round(min(x),3), Max=round(max(x),3),
             Pct_ceiling=round(100*mean(x==max(x)),1))
}

desc_list <- list(
  desc_var(raw$q22_ord,       "Q22 Info level (0–2)"),
  desc_var(raw$info_score,    "Info channels score"),
  desc_var(raw$consult_score, "Consult channels score"),
  desc_var(raw$q24_ord,       "Q24 Signage (0–2)"),
  desc_var(raw$q25,           "Q25 Terminology clarity (1–5)"),
  desc_var(raw$q26,           "Q26 Maintenance satisfaction (1–5)"),
  desc_var(raw$q27_bin,       "Q27 Future benefits (0/1)"),
  desc_var(raw$PL,            "PL composite (IAP2-weighted)"),
  desc_var(raw$perf_composite,"Performance composite Q12–Q21")
)
kable(do.call(rbind, desc_list), caption="Descriptive Statistics")
```

## 3. Non-Parametric Tests: Participation vs Q26 Satisfaction

```{r nonparametric}
library(coin)

groups <- list(
  None    = df_full$q26[df_full$q22_ord == 0],
  Info    = df_full$q26[df_full$q22_ord == 1],
  Consult = df_full$q26[df_full$q22_ord == 2]
)
cat("Group sizes:", sapply(groups, length), "\n")
cat("Group means:", round(sapply(groups, mean, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")

# Kruskal-Wallis
kw_res <- kruskal.test(q26 ~ part_group, data=df_full)
n_tot  <- nrow(df_full)
k      <- length(unique(df_full$part_group[!is.na(df_full$part_group)]))
eps2   <- (kw_res$statistic - k + 1) / (n_tot - k)
cat(sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis: H = %.3f, df = %d, p = %.4f, ε² = %.3f\n",
            kw_res$statistic, kw_res$parameter, kw_res$p.value, eps2))

# Mann-Whitney pairwise (Bonferroni)
pairs_list <- list(c("None","Info"), c("None","Consult"), c("Info","Consult"))
mw_rows <- lapply(pairs_list, function(pr) {
  a <- groups[[pr[1]]]; b <- groups[[pr[2]]]
  if (length(a) < 2 || length(b) < 2) return(NULL)
  res <- wilcox.test(a, b, exact=FALSE)
  r   <- 1 - 2*res$statistic / (length(a)*length(b))
  data.frame(Pair=paste(pr, collapse=" vs "), U=res$statistic,
             p_raw=round(res$p.value,4), p_bonf=round(min(res$p.value*3,1),4),
             r=round(r,3))
})
kable(do.call(rbind, mw_rows), caption="Mann-Whitney U (Bonferroni corrected)")

# Spearman and Kendall
corr_dat <- df_full[complete.cases(df_full[,c("PL","q22_ord","q24_ord","q25","q26")]),]
sp_PL  <- cor.test(corr_dat$PL,       corr_dat$q26, method="spearman")
sp_q22 <- cor.test(corr_dat$q22_ord,  corr_dat$q26, method="spearman")
sp_q25 <- cor.test(corr_dat$q25,      corr_dat$q26, method="spearman")
kt_PL  <- cor.test(corr_dat$PL,       corr_dat$q26, method="kendall")

corr_table <- data.frame(
  Test      = c("Spearman ρ (PL vs Q26)","Spearman ρ (Q22 vs Q26)","Spearman ρ (Q25 vs Q26)","Kendall τ (PL vs Q26)"),
  Statistic = c(round(sp_PL$estimate,3), round(sp_q22$estimate,3), round(sp_q25$estimate,3), round(kt_PL$estimate,3)),
  p_value   = c(round(sp_PL$p.value,4),  round(sp_q22$p.value,4),  round(sp_q25$p.value,4),  round(kt_PL$p.value,4))
)
kable(corr_table, caption="Correlation: Participation vs Q26 Satisfaction")
```

## 4. Jonckheere-Terpstra Trend Test

```{r jt-test}
# Manual JT: H1: None ≤ Info ≤ Consult (ordered increasing)
jt_groups_ord <- list(groups$None, groups$Info, groups$Consult)
jt_groups_ord <- Filter(function(g) length(g) >= 2, jt_groups_ord)

JT <- 0
for (i in seq_along(jt_groups_ord)) {
  for (j in seq_along(jt_groups_ord)) {
    if (j > i) {
      ai <- jt_groups_ord[[i]]; aj <- jt_groups_ord[[j]]
      for (xi in ai) JT <- JT + sum(xi < aj) + 0.5*sum(xi == aj)
    }
  }
}
ns_jt <- sapply(jt_groups_ord, length); N_jt <- sum(ns_jt)
mu_J  <- (N_jt^2 - sum(ns_jt^2)) / 4
var_J <- (N_jt^2*(2*N_jt+3) - sum(ns_jt^2*(2*ns_jt+3))) / 72
Z_JT  <- (JT - mu_J) / sqrt(var_J)
p_JT  <- pnorm(Z_JT, lower.tail=FALSE)  # one-sided: increasing trend

cat(sprintf("Jonckheere-Terpstra: JT = %.1f, z = %.3f, p (one-sided, increasing) = %.4f\n",
            JT, Z_JT, p_JT))
kable(data.frame(Statistic=c("JT","E(JT)","Z","p (one-sided)"),
                 Value=round(c(JT,mu_J,Z_JT,p_JT),4)),
      caption="Jonckheere-Terpstra Trend Test")
```

## 5. Tobit Regression (Ceiling Effect)

```{r tobit}
library(survival)

tobit_dat <- df_full[complete.cases(df_full[,c("PL","q26")]),]
tobit_fit <- survreg(Surv(q26, q26 < 5, type="right") ~ PL,
                     data=tobit_dat, dist="gaussian")
cat("Tobit (right-censored at 5):\n")
print(summary(tobit_fit))

# Compare with OLS
ols_fit <- lm(q26 ~ PL, data=tobit_dat)
cat("\nOLS for comparison:\n")
print(summary(ols_fit))

b_tobit <- coef(tobit_fit)["PL"]
b_ols   <- coef(ols_fit)["PL"]
cat(sprintf("\nTobit β(PL) = %.4f | OLS β(PL) = %.4f | Ratio = %.3f\n",
            b_tobit, b_ols, abs(b_tobit/b_ols)))
```

## 6. lavaan Path Model: PL → Q26

```{r lavaan}
library(lavaan)

lav_dat <- df_full[complete.cases(df_full[,c("PL","q22_norm","q24_norm","q25_norm","q26")]),]

# Formative composite PL → outcome Q26
# Since PL is an observed composite, we model it as a simple regression path
model_lav <- "
  # Direct path: PL (observed IAP2 composite) predicts Q26 satisfaction
  q26 ~ PL + q22_norm + q24_norm + q25_norm
"

fit_lav <- sem(model_lav, data=lav_dat, estimator="MLR")
summary(fit_lav, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

params_lav <- parameterestimates(fit_lav, standardized=TRUE)
path_params <- params_lav[params_lav$op == "~",
                          c("lhs","op","rhs","est","se","z","pvalue","std.all")]
kable(path_params, caption="lavaan Path Coefficients (MLR estimator)", digits=3)

fit_idx <- fitMeasures(fit_lav, c("cfi","rmsea","srmr","chisq","df","pvalue"))
cat("\nFit indices:\n"); print(round(fit_idx, 3))
```

## 7. OLS Regression with Robust SE

```{r ols-robust}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

ols_full <- lm(q26 ~ PL + q22_norm + q24_norm + q25_norm, data=lav_dat)
cat("OLS with HC3 robust SE:\n")
ols_robust_test <- coeftest(ols_full, vcov=vcovHC(ols_full, type="HC3"))
print(ols_robust_test)

cat(sprintf("\nR² = %.3f, Adj R² = %.3f\n",
            summary(ols_full)$r.squared, summary(ols_full)$adj.r.squared))
```

## 8. Binary Logistic: Ceiling (Q26=5) vs Non-Ceiling

```{r ceiling-logistic}
lav_dat$ceiling <- as.integer(lav_dat$q26 == 5)
logit_ceil <- glm(ceiling ~ PL, data=lav_dat, family=binomial)
cat("Logistic regression (Q26=5 vs rest):\n")
print(summary(logit_ceil))
cat("\nOdds ratios:\n")
print(round(exp(cbind(OR=coef(logit_ceil), confint(logit_ceil))), 3))
```

## 9. Visualisations

```{r plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

colours <- c(None="#4878CF", Info="#6ACC65", Consult="#D65F5F")

p1 <- ggplot(df_full[!is.na(df_full$part_group),],
             aes(x=part_group, y=q26, fill=part_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colours) +
  labs(x="Participation group", y="Q26 Maintenance satisfaction",
       title="(a) Satisfaction by participation group") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position="none")

p2 <- ggplot(df_full[!is.na(df_full$PL) & !is.na(df_full$q26),],
             aes(x=PL, y=q26)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.4, colour="steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, colour="red", linetype="dashed") +
  labs(x="Participation Level (PL composite)", y="Q26 Satisfaction",
       title=sprintf("(b) PL vs Q26 (ρ=%.2f, p=%.3f)", sp_PL$estimate, sp_PL$p.value)) +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(df_sat, aes(x=q26)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=1, fill="steelblue", colour="white", alpha=0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=5, colour="red", linetype="dashed") +
  annotate("text", x=4.8, y=Inf, label=paste0("Ceiling: ",
           round(100*mean(df_sat$q26==5,na.rm=TRUE),1),"%"),
           hjust=1, vjust=1.5, colour="red", size=3.5) +
  labs(x="Q26 Satisfaction", y="Count", title="(c) Q26 distribution & ceiling") +
  theme_minimal()

gp <- df_full[!is.na(df_full$part_group),] %>%
  group_by(part_group) %>%
  summarise(Mean=mean(q26,na.rm=TRUE), SD=sd(q26,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

p4 <- ggplot(gp, aes(x=part_group, y=Mean, fill=part_group)) +
  geom_col(alpha=0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Mean-SD, ymax=Mean+SD), width=0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colours) +
  labs(x="Group", y="Mean Q26 ± SD", title="(d) Mean satisfaction by group") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position="none")

(p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4)
```

## 10. EGT Assessment Summary

```{r egt-summary}
egt_df <- data.frame(
  Test = c("Kruskal-Wallis", "Jonckheere-Terpstra (z)", "Spearman ρ (PL)",
           "Kendall τ (PL)", "Cohen's d (Consult-None)", "PLS-SEM β (PL→Q26)"),
  Statistic = c(
    round(kw_res$statistic, 3), round(Z_JT, 3), round(sp_PL$estimate, 3),
    round(kt_PL$estimate, 3),
    round((mean(groups$Consult,na.rm=TRUE)-mean(groups$None,na.rm=TRUE)) /
          sqrt((var(groups$Consult,na.rm=TRUE)+var(groups$None,na.rm=TRUE))/2), 3),
    NA
  ),
  p_value = c(
    round(kw_res$p.value, 4), round(p_JT, 4), round(sp_PL$p.value, 4),
    round(kt_PL$p.value, 4), NA, NA
  ),
  Direction = c("n.s.", "negative (−)", "negative (−)", "negative (−)",
                "negative (−)", "see Python output"),
  EGT_supported = c("No (n.s.)", "No (n.s.)", "No (n.s.)", "No (n.s.)", "Direction only", "Inconclusive")
)

kable(egt_df, caption="EGT Assessment: All tests non-significant (p>0.05)")

cat("\n=== EGT VERDICT ===\n")
cat("Expectation Gap Theory: NOT CONFIRMED\n")
cat("All tests are statistically non-significant (p > 0.05).\n")
cat("Direction of effects is slightly negative (consistent with EGT)\n")
cat("but effect sizes are negligible (|ρ| < 0.13, |d| < 0.27).\n")
cat("Conclusion: Participation level does not significantly predict\n")
cat("maintenance satisfaction in this Qinghe Park sample.\n")
```
